title: Avenger Titan (Aegis Dynamics, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Avenger Titan is a light fighter from Aegis Dynamics in Star Citizen that can also carry some freight. The pilot sits alone at the front; behind the cockpit a small cargo bay takes the place of the original Avenger's rear cabin. The common controls apply unchanged.

panels.name: Avenger Titan: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Avenger Titan's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (three)
controls.text: The Avenger Titan has three guns that the pilot fires. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (four missiles)
controls.text: Four missiles hang in the Avenger Titan's racks. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

controls.name: Cargo bay (8 SCU)
controls.text: Behind the cockpit sits a small cargo bay for 8 SCU of goods.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.
